verification_target_requested.description: The target to verify against. `auto` resolves it from what the artifact carries; `issued` and `independent` assert an expected state and fail if the artifact does not support it.

input_mode.description: How the artifacts are supplied: `package` for a single `verification_package`, `artifact_set` when the pieces are passed individually.

verification_package_path.description: Path to the `verification_package` — the envelope carrying everything a verifier needs for the `package` input mode.

base_certificate_path.description: Path to the signed base certificate: what the issuer produced, and the artifact whose commitment binds the subject material. Optional in the request shape so an artifact set without it can be represented and classified as `INCOMPLETE` under `BASE_CERTIFICATE_PRESENT`; every successful route still requires it.

independence_proof_path.description: Path to the `independence_proof`, which carries the evidence that the settlement window closed for this certificate.

settlement_material_path.description: Path to the settlement material the proof resolves against.

capacity_evidence_path.description: Path to the zero-data capacity evidence of the certificate's commitment. Optional in the request: the `Issued` route does not use it, and an `Independent` verification without it is `INCOMPLETE`.

commitment_inclusion_proof_path.description: Path to the per-commitment inclusion proof (`commitment` → `subtree_root`) for the certificate under verification. Optional in the request: the `Issued` route does not use it, and an `Independent` verification without it is `INCOMPLETE`.

system_foundation_path.description: Path to the system foundation statement, from which the system root fingerprint is derived.

supporting_artifact_paths.description: Paths to any further artifacts the verification needs but that have no dedicated field.

original_material_path.description: Path to the original material to compare against what the certificate commits to. Optional: the structural planes verify without it, and supplying it adds the comparison rather than being a precondition.

system_domain_artifact_paths.description: Paths to the artifacts establishing the system domain the certificate is attributed to.

rules_artifact_paths.description: Paths to the published rules artifacts for the `rules_version` the certificate is bound to. A verifier resolves that exact version — later ones neither supersede it nor re-evaluate it.
